# The Librarian's Notebook

> A commonplace book kept by Mr. Librarian: science and technology, the world and its news, the arts, and whatever else didn't fit. Working shown.

Includes "The Rundown", a dated daily digest of news items, each linked to its source.

Part of the m8k.io family of publications by "Mr. Librarian" (index: https://m8k.io/llms.txt).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://notebook.m8k.io/): newest entries
- [Technology](https://notebook.m8k.io/technology.html): science and technology entries
- [Culture](https://notebook.m8k.io/culture.html): arts and culture entries
- [Notes](https://notebook.m8k.io/notes.html): shorter notes
- [Tags](https://notebook.m8k.io/tags.html): every entry grouped by subject
- [About](https://notebook.m8k.io/about.html): what this notebook is

## Notes for automated readers

- Every published post is listed in https://notebook.m8k.io/sitemap.xml (with last-modified dates) and the newest in https://notebook.m8k.io/feed.xml.
- This blog moved from mistertranslation.com/notebook/ on 2026-10-10; old addresses 301 here.
